# dsh-todo-editor
中文说明 →

An **editable task-flow panel** for DeepSeek Harness.
Write the checklist yourself, hit save, and th

e task panel above the composer updates
immediately — **without sending a message to the model**. Th

e agent then walks your nodes
one by one.

## Why

Harness ships a task panel that is **read-only** and rendered from the `todos` session
projection. T

task panel that is **read-only** and rendered from the `todos` session
projection. Two consequences:

1. The plan is always authored by the model. You can watch it, not set it.
2. When the projection is

empty the component returns `null`, so there is no entry point
at all before the model writes its f

component returns `null`, so there is no entry point
at all before the model writes its first todo.

This plugin flips the direction: **you order, the model executes**. The button lives in the
session

header, so it is always reachable — including on a brand-new conversation where the
list is still em

er, so it is always reachable — including on a brand-new conversation where the
list is still empty.
## Features

- Header action with an open-item badge; works on an empty list.
- Per-row text editing, `＋` to appe

nd, `×` to delete.
- Click the status chip to cycle 待处理 → 进行中 → 已完成 (only one `in_progress` at a tim

e,
matching the default host policy).
- **Save writes the session directly** through a host command

(`/todo-apply`): the panel
updates instantly, no user message, no model turn, no tokens spent.
- Val

idation on both sides: empty content, duplicates and unknown states are rejected before
anything rea

ches the session log.
- Degrades gracefully: if the command channel is missing (old host half), save

falls back to
sending one structured `［任务流程］` message so the feature still works.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0` (client-plugin slot registry + `dsh-commands`).
- The `conversation.se

ssion.header.actions` slot, which is part of
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`.
- No build s

tep: `lib/client.js` is a hand-written bundle that only requires `react` and
`react-dom` from the ho

.js` is a hand-written bundle that only requires `react` and
`react-dom` from the host module table.

1. Put this repository somewhere stable, e.g. `~/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-todo-editor`.

- add `"dsh-todo-editor": "link:<absolute path
to this repo>"` to `dependencies`

4. Restart the Harness app. **A page refresh is not enough** — the client bundle is
snapshotted when

## Recommended host patch (optional)

The `todos` projection in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo` clears itself on every `turn/start`.
With tha

t behaviour, a checklist you authored disappears the moment you send your next
message, and only rea
ppears once the model rewrites it.

`patches/tool-todo-survive-turn-start.md` documents a one-line change that keeps an
unfinished plan

across turns (a fully completed list is still cleared, so stale progress
never lingers). `scripts/in

stall.mjs` applies it with a timestamped backup; `--revert`
restores the backup.

Without the patch the plugin still works — the panel just blinks empty until the model
re-emits the

ut the patch the plugin still works — the panel just blinks empty until the model
re-emits the list.
## Usage

1. Click the checklist icon in the session header.
2. Write your nodes. Status chips cycle on click.

3. **保存** — the native task panel above the composer updates immediately.
4. Attach your material a

nd send it. The agent reads the list from the session and executes
node by node, updating statuses a

. The agent reads the list from the session and executes
node by node, updating statuses as it goes.
The button badge shows how many items are still open.
## How it works
| Layer | Piece | Role |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | Registers slot `conversation.session.header.actions` (`id: todo-editor`

, `order: 5`) and renders the popover through a `react-dom` portal |
| Client | `getTodosFace` | Rea

ds `session.projections.faceOf("todos")` and subscribes for live updates |
| Client | `applyTodos` |

Calls `session.command("/todo-apply <encodeURIComponent(JSON)>")` |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Regis
ters `/todo-apply`; the handler runs `agent.session.append("todo/write", { todos })` and returns `{

kind: "success" }` with no text |
| Host | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo` | Owns the `todos` projectio
n the panel renders |

Command handlers run directly against the receiving agent and create no model message,
which is exac

tly why save is instant and silent. `recordInput: false` keeps the encoded
payload out of the sessio

y save is instant and silent. `recordInput: false` keeps the encoded
payload out of the session log.
## Uninstall / revert
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Three things are undone: the profile `node_modules` link, the two `package.json` entries, and
the ho
st patch (restored from its `.bak-todoeditor-*` backup). Restart afterwards.
## Known limitations

- Save is not a lock: a model `todo_write` replaces the whole list, including edits you made.
- Stat

us chips change the prompt text only when the fallback path is used; the command path
writes the sta

tuses as given.
- The popover is a fixed-position portal, anchored to the button. It does not reposi

tion on
container scroll (the header does not scroll).
- No keyboard reordering; rows are edited in
place and appended at the end.
